description: All execution-phase modules exist in isolation but nothing connects them. Write src/run/execute.ts with an executeRun(batch, deps) function that sequences: claimOrAbort → hydrateContext → normalizeContext → RepoManager.prepareWorktree → AgentRunner.run → RepoManager.pushBranch → createPrForIssueTask (if sourceType === issue_comment) → updateStatusComment (completed or failed). Wire it into main.ts by instantiating RepoManager (reposDir/worktreesDir from config or state dir), CommandRunner (agent command from config), and DispatchOrchestrator, and passing executeRun as the onRunReady callback. The orchestrator handles debounce and concurrency; execute.ts handles the single-run lifecycle. After this ticket Otto should be runnable end-to-end.
title: Run executor — wire trigger through to agent run and status update
